fillerCut.hint: Drag the handles until only the filler is inside, then listen both ways. Dips below the dashed line are pauses.

clips.label: Clips
clips.clipLabel: Clip {number}: plays {duration}, from {source} of the take
clips.reorderHint: Drag a clip, or press Alt+← / Alt+→ on it, to change the order.
clips.selectionHint: Click a clip to select it, Shift+click to select a run of clips to merge.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.no_audio: This video has no audio track to transcribe.
transcript.too_long: Transcripts work on clips up to 5 minutes for now. Silences are still flagged on the timeline.
transcript.filler: Filler word: Clean up removes it
transcript.fillerReview: Filler word with no clear pause around it: cut it by hand from its flag on the timeline

confirm.plan: I'll keep {start}–{end} ({kept} s) and remove the rest of the clip ({removed} s).
confirm.title: I'll show the title “{text}” from {start} to {end} of the edited video.
confirm.watermarkNew: I'll put your logo in the {corner} corner for the whole video. Choose the image next.
confirm.watermarkMove: I'll move the watermark to the {corner} corner.
confirm.captionsOn: I'll turn captions on, from the transcript.
confirm.merge: I'll merge clips {from} to {to} into one.
confirm.cleanup: I'll remove about {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of long silences and filler words.
confirm.redo: I'll redo the change you undid.
confirm.reset: I'll reset to the original take, removing every edit. Undo brings them back.
confirm.speed: I'll preview at {rate}×. The export isn't affected: to change a clip's real speed, say “make clip 2 play at 2x”.
confirm.rerecord: I'll open the re-record panel for “{text}” at {at}.
confirm.export: I'll export the edit as a video file. It takes as long as the edit plays.
confirm.findHighlights: I'll find the best moments in the transcript and show them in a pop-up, to watch and download. Your edit won't change.
confirm.box: I'll cover the {region} with a black box from {start} to {end}. It stays in place: it won't follow anything that moves.
confirm.blur: I'll blur the {region} from {start} to {end}. It stays in place: it won't follow anything that moves.
confirm.pixelate: I'll pixelate the {region} from {start} to {end}. It stays in place: it won't follow anything that moves.
confirm.rotate: I'll turn the video {degrees}° {direction, select, clockwise {clockwise} other {anticlockwise}}, to {to}°. The corners it leaves are black: crop them away if you like.

flip.horizontal: I'll flip the video horizontally: left and right swap.
flip.vertical: I'll flip the video vertically: it turns upside down.

confirm.crop: I'll crop the video to {aspect}, centred. You can move the crop box afterwards.
confirm.fade_in: I'll fade {which} in over its first {seconds} s.
confirm.fade_out: I'll fade {which} out over its last {seconds} s.
confirm.clipSpeed: I'll make {which} play at {speed}×, in the preview and the export, its pitch kept.
confirm.clipSpeedSkipping: I'll make every clip play at {speed}×, in the preview and the export, its pitch kept. Clips with a re-recorded sentence stay at 1×.
confirm.transition: I'll add a {kind, select, fade {fade through black} other {dissolve}} of {seconds} s between {which}.
confirm.transitionShortened: Where the clips either side are short, it plays shorter.
confirm.removeTransition: I'll take the transition off between {which}: a plain cut.
confirm.deleteClip: I'll delete clip {number}: its part of the video won't play. Undo brings it back.
confirm.duplicateClip: I'll duplicate clip {number}, with its sound and speed, and put the copy right after it.
confirm.colorNormal: I'll put the colors of {which} back to normal.
confirm.addAudio: I'll add an audio file at {at} of the edited video. Choose the file next.
confirm.extractAudio: I'll take clip {number}'s sound out into its own track in the Audio lane; the clip itself goes silent.
confirm.deleteAudio: I'll delete audio track {number} from the Audio lane.
confirm.addVideo: I'll add another video after the clips. Choose the file next.
confirm.openProject: I'll open “{name}” in place of this edit.
confirm.openProjectUnsaved: I'll open “{name}” in place of this edit. This edit has changes that were never saved: they'll be lost.
confirm.lowerThird: I'll show a lower third saying “{name}” from {start} to {end}, sliding in and out.
confirm.animate: I'll make {target, select, title {the title} other {the text on the video}} {phase, select, in {come in} other {go out}} with {kind, select, none {no animation} fade {a fade} pop {a pop} other {a slide {phase, select, in {from} other {to}} the {side}}} over {seconds} s.
confirm.zoom: I'll {direction, select, in {push in to} other {pull out from}} {percent}% from {start} to {end}, on the whole picture.

unsupported.title: I can't do that yet.
unsupported.commandsIntro: As a typed command, I can:
unsupported.trimRange: Keep a time range: “cut from 2 to 5 seconds”, “keep 1:05 to 1:20”
unsupported.trimToEnd: Keep from a point to the end: “cut from 3 seconds to the end”
unsupported.merge: Merge clips: “merge clips 2 and 3”, “merge all clips”
unsupported.reorder: Reorder clips: “move clip 2 to the start”
unsupported.cleanup: Remove long silences and filler words: “clean up the recording”
unsupported.undoRedo: Undo, redo, or start over: “undo”, “redo”, “reset to the original”
unsupported.reRecord: Re-record a sentence: “re-record the sentence at 0:25”
unsupported.highlights: Find the best moments to watch and download: “find the highlights”
unsupported.addTitle: Add a title card: “add the title Welcome for the first 3 seconds”
unsupported.addWatermark: Add a logo watermark: “put my logo in the top-right corner”
unsupported.captions: Turn captions on or off: “turn captions on”
unsupported.annotate: Cover, blur or pixelate part of the picture: “pixelate the top-left corner from 2 to 5 seconds”
unsupported.transform: Rotate, flip or crop the video: “rotate the video 15 degrees”, “flip it horizontally”, “crop to 9:16”
unsupported.audio: Change the sound: “mute clip 2”, “make it louder”, “fade out the last 2 seconds”
unsupported.editorIntro: In the editor itself, you can also:
unsupported.fillerCut: Cut a single filler word by ear: click its flag on the timeline
unsupported.compare: Compare the edit with the original: Edited / Original above the player
unsupported.annotations: Draw boxes, blurs, pixelates and text on the video, then move, resize and retime them: Annotations, under the clips
unsupported.transformByHand: Drag a crop box or a rotation handle on the video: Picture, under the clips
unsupported.clipSpeed: Make a clip really play faster or slower: “make clip 2 play at 2x”, “slow the last clip to half speed”
unsupported.transitions: Add a transition between clips: “add a fade between clips 1 and 2”, “dissolve between all clips”
unsupported.deleteDuplicate: Delete or duplicate a clip: “delete clip 3”, “duplicate the first clip”
unsupported.color: Change the colors: “make it black and white”, “increase the brightness”, “make clip 2 warmer”
unsupported.textStyle: Style text: “make the title red”, “make the captions bigger”, “use a serif font for the title”
unsupported.pencil: Draw freehand on the video: Pencil, in Annotations, under the clips
unsupported.audioLane: Separate audio: “add music at 0:05”, “extract the audio of clip 2”, “delete the music”
unsupported.addVideo: Add another video to the project: “add another video”
unsupported.projects: Save or open a project: “save the project”, “open my project Holiday”
unsupported.motion: Animate: “add a lower third saying Jane, CEO from 5 to 10 seconds”, “slide the title in from the left”, “zoom in slowly from 10 to 15 seconds”

refused.no_such_clip: There's no clip with that number. The Clips strip numbers them from 1.
refused.cannot_split: I can't split there: it's too close to a clip's edge, outside the edit, or inside a re-recorded sentence.
refused.nothing_to_clean: There's nothing clean-up can remove right now.
refused.nothing_to_reset: The edit is already the original take.
refused.no_sentence: I can't find a sentence at that time in the transcript.
refused.nothing_to_export: Nothing plays in this edit, so there's nothing to export.
refused.cannot_rerecord: I can't re-record that sentence yet.
refused.unsupported_clip_speed: A clip can play from 0.25× to 4×.
refused.speed_with_take: That clip has a re-recorded sentence, which plays as recorded, so its speed stays 1×.
refused.not_adjacent: A transition goes between two clips side by side, like clips 1 and 2.
refused.no_join: There's only one clip, so there's no join for a transition. Split it first.
refused.transition_blocked: There's a re-recorded sentence or a very short clip at that join, so a transition can't go there.
refused.only_clip: That's the only clip: deleting it would leave nothing to play.
refused.colors_already_normal: The colors there are already as recorded.
refused.no_title: There's no title yet. Add one first, then style it.
refused.no_text: There's no text on the video yet. Add some with the Text tool first.
refused.audio_after_end: That's past the end of the edited video.
refused.no_audio: There's no audio track in the Audio lane yet.
refused.no_such_audio: There's no audio track with that number. The Audio lane numbers them from 1.
refused.extract_sped: That clip is sped up or slowed down. Set it back to 1× to take its sound out.
refused.extract_take: That clip has a re-recorded sentence, so its sound can't be taken out as it is.
refused.extract_already: That clip's sound is already in the Audio lane.
refused.merge_videos: Those clips are from different videos, so they can't be one clip.
refused.no_projects: There are no saved projects yet.
refused.no_such_project: There's no saved project by that name. My projects lists them.

out_of_range.title: That range isn't in this clip.
out_of_range.description: Pick a start before the end, both within 0:00–{duration}.

chat.label: Chat
chat.intro: Say what to change in your own words. Retake shows what it understood first; nothing changes until you press Apply changes.
chat.attachHint: A video is added to the project, a PNG or JPG becomes the logo, and an audio file goes on the Audio lane.

attached.video: Added {name} as another video, after the others.
attached.audio: Put {name} on the Audio lane at the playhead.
attached.unknown: I can’t use {name}: attach a video, a PNG or JPG image, or an audio file.

example.cleanup: Remove the filler words and long silences
example.title: Add a title that says Welcome
example.zoom: Zoom in slowly from 2 to 5 seconds

chat.title: Ask Retake to edit
chat.voiceTip: Tip: press the mic below to say it instead.
chat.short: Retake shows what it understood first; nothing changes until you press Apply changes.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.fillerCount: {count, plural, one {# filler word} other {# filler words}}
timeline.fillerPinLabel: Filler word "{word}" at {at}. Open the cut editor
timeline.fillerReviewPinLabel: Filler word "{word}" at {at}, needs a manual cut (no clear pause around it). Open the cut editor
timeline.empty: Your timeline appears here once a video loads.

clipping.count: {count, plural, one {# clipped stretch} other {# clipped stretches}}
clipping.pin: Clipping from {start} to {end}: the sound hit the maximum level and may crackle or distort. Jump there
clipping.meaning: Clipping: the sound hit the maximum level the recording can hold, so it may crackle or distort there.

quiet.count: {count, plural, one {# quiet stretch} other {# quiet stretches}}
quiet.pin: Quiet speech from {start} to {end}: much quieter than the rest of the recording, and may be hard to hear. Jump there
quiet.meaning: Quiet speech: at least 15 dB quieter than the rest of the recording for a few seconds, so it may be hard to hear.

noise.count: {count, plural, one {# noisy stretch} other {# noisy stretches}}
noise.pin: Loud background from {start} to {end}: the background is nearly as loud as the speech. Jump there
noise.meaning: Loud background: the sound between words is close to the level of the speech, so the speech may be hard to follow.

audio.note: These flags only point things out: nothing has been changed, and the editor can't fix them yet.

lanes.textEmpty: Titles, text and marks show here

graphics.label: Graphics
graphics.titleHint: Times are in the edited video: 0 is where the export starts.
graphics.logoBox: Logo: drag to move it, drag its corner to resize it, drag the handle above to turn it; arrow keys move it, + and − resize it, [ and ] turn it
graphics.logoHint: Drag the logo on the video to place it anywhere, and its corner to resize it.
graphics.captionsHint: From the transcript, over the bottom of the video.

notAPng.title: That isn't a PNG or JPG
notAPng.description: {name} can't be used as a watermark. Choose a PNG or JPG image.

captionModes.lines: A line or two at a time

annotations.label: Annotations
annotations.hint: Pick a tool and drag on the video to draw; Pencil draws a line freehand in the color above; Select moves an item, or resizes it from its corner. A new item shows for 3 seconds from the playhead.
annotations.staysPut: Boxes and blurs stay where you put them: they don't follow anything that moves in the video.
annotations.lane: When each shows, in the edited video
annotations.barHint: Drag to move it in time, or its edges to change when it starts and ends. Arrow keys move it; Delete removes it.

clipAudio.label: Clip sound and speed
clipAudio.hint: Fades run over each clip's own playing time, cuts skipped. A re-recorded sentence keeps its own level matching; the clip's volume and fades apply on top. Over 100% can clip loud speech. Speed is 0.25× to 4×, the pitch kept; a clip with a re-recorded sentence stays at 1×.
clipAudio.speedWithTake: This clip has a re-recorded sentence, which plays as recorded: its speed stays 1×.
clipAudio.inLane: Its sound is in the Audio lane.

transform.label: Picture
transform.hint: Applies to the whole video. Rotating leaves black corners; a crop takes them away. Annotations stay on the picture; the title, captions and logo stay in the frame.
transform.originalHint: Switch to Edited to change the picture.

speed.label: Preview speed
speed.hint: Only how fast the editor plays. The export always runs at normal speed.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.panel: Retake picks the 3 to 5 best moments from the transcript, each on whole sentences. Watch them and download any one. Your edit stays as it is.
highlights.description: The best moments of your video, from its transcript. Pick one to watch it. A download is that moment of the original recording, without your edits. Nothing here changes your edit.
highlights.none: No clear highlights were found in this video.

noTranscript.analyzing: Retake is still reading the video. Highlights come from its transcript, and appear here once it is ready.
noTranscript.transcribing: Retake is still writing the transcript. Highlights come from it, and appear here once it is ready.
noTranscript.too_long: Highlights need a transcript, and Retake writes transcripts only for videos up to 5 minutes long. This video is longer, so Retake can't find its highlights.
noTranscript.no_audio: This video has no sound, so there is no transcript to find highlights in.
noTranscript.failed: The transcript couldn't be written, so Retake can't find highlights in this video.
noTranscript.empty: No speech was heard in this video, so there are no highlights to find.

export.hint: Plays the edit through once to record it, so it takes as long as the edit runs. Keep this tab open and in front.

wrongLength.title: {name} came out the wrong length
wrongLength.description: This export came out {seconds} s too {direction, select, long {long} other {short}}, probably because the computer ran low on memory. Close other apps and export again.

hidden.title: Export stopped: this tab was hidden.
hidden.description: A hidden tab stops recording the video, so nothing was saved. Export again, and keep this tab open and in front until it finishes.

empty.title: The export came out empty.
empty.description: Nothing was recorded, so there is no file to download. Export again, and keep this tab open and in front while it runs.

export.gettingReadyHint: The editor is still reading the video. Export opens in a moment.

unsupported.title: This browser can't export video.
unsupported.description: Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

reRecord.label: Re-record the sentence at {at}
reRecord.title: Re-record the sentence at {at}
reRecord.hint: Say the sentence again. Your new take replaces the original sound; the picture keeps playing underneath, so say it to match what is on screen.

blocked.no_gap_before: There is no clear pause before this sentence, so the join can’t be placed automatically. You can set it by ear.
blocked.no_gap_after: There is no clear pause after this sentence, so the join can’t be placed automatically. You can set it by ear.
blocked.trimmed: Part of this sentence is trimmed away. Move the trim handles to include all of it first.
blocked.split: This sentence is split between two clips. Merge them first.
blocked.overlaps: This sentence overlaps one you’ve already re-recorded.
blocked.sped: This sentence is in a sped-up or slowed clip. Set the clip back to 1× to re-record it.
blocked.deleted: This sentence is in a deleted clip, so it doesn’t play. Undo the delete to re-record it.
blocked.in_lane: This sentence’s clip has its sound in the Audio lane. Undo that to re-record it.

reRecord.recording: Recording… say the sentence, pause a moment, then press Stop.
reRecord.noSpeech: No speech was heard in that recording. Check your microphone and try again.

micUnavailable.title: Can’t use the microphone
micUnavailable.description: Allow microphone access for this site and check a microphone is connected, then try again.

reRecord.byEarNote: A join set by ear isn’t guaranteed to be clean: play the new take in place before you use it.

join.hint: Drag each handle to where the sentence starts and ends. The shaded part is what the new take replaces; dips below the dashed line are the quietest moments.

reRecord.stoppedMidSpeech: Stop was pressed while you were still speaking, so the end of the take would be cut off. Record again, and pause a moment before pressing Stop.

transitions.label: Transitions
transitions.shortened: Plays {seconds} s here: the clips either side are short.
transitions.notPossible: Not here: a re-recorded sentence or a very short clip is at this join.
transitions.hint: A fade goes through black and keeps the video's length; a dissolve blends one clip into the next and shortens it by the dissolve's length. Moving or deleting a clip takes the transitions at its joins with it.
transitions.none: Transitions go between clips. Split the video (or add another) to make a join, then pick a fade or dissolve for it here.

color.label: Color
color.hint: A clip's colors go on top of the whole video's. 100% is as recorded.

audioLane.label: Audio

blocked.sped: Sped up or slowed: set it back to 1× first.
blocked.already: Its sound is already in the lane.

audioLane.empty: No audio tracks yet: add a file, or take a clip’s sound out into its own track.
audioLane.hint: Audio tracks play over the video, mixed, in the edited video’s time: drag one to move it, its edges to trim it. A clip’s sound taken out stays where you put it while the clip itself goes silent.
audioLane.noSound: This video has no sound to take out.

projects.label: Project
projects.name: Project name
projects.savedAt: Saved at {time}; saves itself after each change.
projects.none: No saved projects yet. Saved projects are kept in this browser.
projects.storageFull: Your browser’s storage is full. Delete a project or free some space, then save again.
projects.relinkHint: This browser no longer holds some of this project’s files (its storage was cleared). Pick each one again; it’s taken only if its name and size match.

motion.hint: An entrance and an exit each take at most half the time it shows.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.hint: A slow push-in from the whole picture to the zoom, or a pull-out back from it, between two times of the edited video, about the frame’s centre. Annotations zoom with the picture; the title, captions, lower third and logo stay put.
zoom.aimHint: Set area on video shows the whole picture with the zoom’s area on it: drag the area to aim the zoom, drag its corner to zoom closer or wider.
zoom.aimNeedsZoom: Add a zoom first, then set its area on the video.

voice.nothingHeard: Nothing was heard. Try again a little closer to the mic.

noMic.title: No microphone
noMic.description: Allow microphone access in your browser to speak a command.

tools.label: Editing tools
tools.found: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} found

colour.label: Colour

transcript.label: Transcript

transcript.keywords: words text sentences re-record retake speech pauses filler

highlights.label: Find highlights
highlights.help: The best moments of the video, to watch and download.
highlights.keywords: highlights best moments clips shorts reels short vertical

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your latest changes aren’t saved yet. If you leave now, they’re lost.

onVideo.emptyText: Nothing yet. Pick Title, Text or Logo above.
onVideo.emptyMarks: Nothing yet. Pick one above, or the pencil to draw.
onVideo.moveHint: Drag it on the video to move it. Drag a corner to resize.
onVideo.drawHint: Draw on the video with the pointer. Each line is one change.

original.title: Original — view only.
original.body: This is your recording as it came in. Switch to Edited to make changes.
original.toolsNote: You're looking at the original. Nothing can be changed here: switch to Edited to edit.

videos.label: Videos
videos.help: An added video plays after the others as a clip of its own: split, reorder and trim it like any clip.

studio.title: Retake AI
studio.help: Ask for changes in your own words. You approve each one.
studio.undoHint: Undo, at the top, takes all of this back in one step.
studio.finerBody: Open the timeline, the transcript and every tool. Your AI edit comes with you.

followUp.label: The changed plan
followUp.intro: Ask for a change to the plan in your own words. Retake shows what would change first; nothing changes until you press Apply changes.
followUp.unchanged: Nothing in the plan would change.
followUp.handEdited: The edit was changed by hand since the plan was applied. Applying this replaces those changes.

resolved.applied: Applied. Undo, at the top, goes back to the plan before.
resolved.cancelled: Cancelled. The plan stays as it was.

captions.bold_words: one big word at a time

followUp.unclear: Retake couldn’t update the plan just now. Try again in a moment.
followUp.noPlan: Retake couldn’t change the plan from that. Try saying it another way.
followUp.failed: Something went wrong updating the plan. Try again in a moment.

footer.label: Footer
footer.tagline: A video editor for the web. Keep the moment, lose the mess.

landing.title: Keep the moment. Lose the mess.
landing.description: Retake is a video editor for the web. Tell it what you want, a reel, a funnier cut, a polished ad, and it plans the edit for you to approve. Or take the timeline yourself, with help a message away.
landing.storyTitle: From “I'll fix it later” to done, in five scenes.

bring.label: Bring it in
bring.title: Start with what you already have.
bring.body: The talk you gave, the trip you filmed, the demo you recorded at midnight. Drop it in and Retake listens to every word.

say.label: Say it
say.title: Describe the video you want.
say.body: “Make this an Instagram reel.” “Make it funny.” Say it the way you would to a friend. Retake answers with a plan, not a surprise.
say.pill: Nothing changes until you press Apply

tidy.label: Tidy up
tidy.title: Lose the ums. Keep the point.
tidy.body: Filler words and long pauses, gone in one click. Or go through them one by one if you like to choose.
tidy.pill: One click, or one by one

yours.label: Make it yours
yours.title: Add your touch.
yours.body: Captions that pop in word by word, a zoom on the moment that matters, a crop for any screen. Ask the assistant when typing is quicker.

share.label: Share it
share.title: Take the best bits with you.
share.body: Retake finds the strongest moments and hands them back as clips you can download, cropped to vertical for Reels and Shorts.
share.pill: Your original stays as it is

make.title: One sentence in. A finished edit out.

ask.title: Nothing changes until you say so.
ask.body: Every AI edit arrives as a plan or a preview first. Apply it, change it, or let it go.

undo.title: Undo is always one click away.
undo.body: Your edits and the AI's, forwards and backwards, as many times as you like.

browser.title: It lives in your browser.
browser.body: Nothing to install. Open Retake, bring a video, start.

upload.label: Upload
upload.title: Upload a video.
upload.body: Drag it in or browse. Retake writes a transcript so it knows what you said.

describe.label: Describe
describe.title: Say what it should become.
describe.body: Type it or speak it: “make this an Instagram reel”, “make it funny”, “make this an ad”.

review.label: Review
review.title: Read the plan.
review.body: Shape, length, cuts, captions and on-screen text, listed step by step. Not right? Change your request in plain words.

apply.label: Apply
apply.title: Press Apply.
apply.body: Only now does the video change. It opens in the editor, where you can keep asking the assistant or use the timeline.

export.label: Export
export.title: Download it.
export.body: Tweak anything on the timeline first if you like, or add music of your own on the Audio lane, then export.

upload.label: Upload
upload.title: Upload a video.
upload.body: Choose Edit by hand and the editor opens on the transcript and the tools, with the assistant a tab away.

tidy.label: Tidy
tidy.title: Clean it up.
tidy.body: Long pauses and filler words are flagged. Remove them in one click, or one by one.

what.question: What is Retake?
what.answer: A video editor in your web browser. Describe the video you want and let Retake plan and build it, or edit it yourself on a timeline with an assistant to help.

free.question: Is Retake free?
free.answer: Yes. Retake is free while it's in beta, with every feature included.

asking.question: Will it change my video without asking?
asking.answer: No. Every AI edit shows you a plan or a preview first, and nothing changes until you press Apply.

undo.question: Can I undo an edit?
undo.answer: Yes. Undo and redo cover every change, yours and the AI's, and Reset takes you back to the original.

install.question: Do I need to install anything?
install.answer: No. Retake runs in your web browser. Open it, bring a video and start.

videos.question: Which videos can I upload?
videos.answer: MP4, WebM and MOV files. Transcripts, Make it and highlights work on videos up to 5 minutes.

vertical.question: Can I make vertical clips?
vertical.answer: Yes. Make it can turn a video into a vertical reel, TikTok or Short, and highlights can be downloaded cropped to 9:16.

rerecord.question: Can I fix one sentence without filming it all again?
rerecord.answer: Yes. Pick the sentence in the transcript and record it again. Retake puts the new take where the old one was. If there is no clear pause around it, you set the joins by ear.

kept.question: Where are my videos kept?
kept.answer: In your browser. Editing, previews and export run on your computer, and saved projects stay in this browser. The audio is sent to Deepgram for a transcript. Commands, and for Make it the transcript and small pictures taken every 2 seconds, are sent to Google Gemini. The video file itself is never uploaded.

limits.title: Any limits during beta?
limits.body: Transcripts, Make it and highlights work on videos up to 5 minutes. The AI has a daily limit for each account: {command} typed commands, {voice} spoken commands, {transcript} transcripts, {highlights} highlight searches and {makeIt} Make it steps a day (a plan uses two, since each plan is checked, and each change asked in the chat uses one), reset at midnight UTC. Projects are saved in your browser, so how many you keep depends on its storage.

privacy.title: Your videos, your call.
privacy.description: What Retake collects when you use it, why, and the choices you have, in plain language.

items.0: Retake is a video editor for the web, in beta. Questions about this policy reach us through the contact page.
Account details: your email address, and your password, kept by our sign-in service (Supabase).
items.1: Your videos: they stay on your computer. Editing, previews and export run in your browser, and saved projects, with their video, are kept in this browser, not on our servers.
items.2: Usage information: which pages are visited and what is clicked (PostHog), and reports of errors so we can fix them (Sentry). Never your videos.
items.3: Messages: what you send through the contact page, with your name and email, so we can reply. With each message we keep a coded form of your network address (a one-way code, never the address itself), only to stop the form being flooded.

items.0: To run Retake for you: transcribe your videos, find filler words and pauses, plan and apply the edits you approve, find highlights, and answer your messages.
Deepgram receives a video's audio, to write the transcript and to understand spoken commands.
items.1: Google Gemini receives typed or spoken commands as text, the transcript's text when you find highlights, and for Make it the transcript and small pictures taken from the video every 2 seconds, to plan the edit.
items.2: The video file itself is never uploaded.

items.0: Projects stay in your browser until you delete them or clear the browser's data. We don't keep your videos, audio or transcripts on our servers. Your account and the messages you send are kept until you ask us to delete them.
You can delete any project at any time from Projects, which removes it and its video from this browser. To delete your account or a message you sent, write to us through the contact page.
If this policy changes, we will update the date above.
